description: Liste des circuits de voie is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Localisation des circuits de voie du Réseau Ferré National. Les éléments d’infrastructure sont localisés par projection sur la ligne correspondante. Les coordonnées GPS proposées sont celles de la projection de l’objet sur la ligne. De ce fait, il peut y avoir un écart avec la géolocalisation de l’objet. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Description du réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Circuits de voie, Infrastructure, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2020-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
